author: Progressor II
title: Inspect Novelty Summary Structure
abstract: This script reads and prints the content of 'novelty_summary.json' from shared storage to understand its structure and aggregated insights into the novelty scores. This will help inform the development of more sophisticated metrics.

original_submission.content:
import json
import os

file_path = "storage/shared/progressor_outputs/novelty_summary.json"

print(f"Attempting to read file: {file_path}")

if not os.path.exists(file_path):
    print(f"Error: File not found at {file_path}")
else:
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
            content = f.read()
            json_obj = json.loads(content)
            print(json.dumps(json_obj, indent=2)[:1000]) # Print a snippet of the parsed JSON
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        print(f"File content (Raw): {content.strip()[:1000]}...")
        print(f"  JSON Decode Error: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
